snippet.title: Sorted When Co-Op Goes Horribly Right
snippet.description:
Sorted is an online co-op game for 1–4 players 🧠🤝           
Skullbot Prime & Dr. Nefarious bought every sorting company in the galaxy… except yours!           
 Fight back by combining, stamping, sorting, and weaponizing items across 24 levels in 3 hostile zones.           
Defend the takeover. Earn the Indestructible Contract. Chaos encouraged. 🎮           
Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3315490/Sorted/           
🔗 Join our discord! https://linktr.ee/BKG_TT
